description: Check whether a GS1 identifier is valid, including its mod-10 check digit. Accepts a GS1 Digital Link URI (https://id.gs1.org/01/09521000002159/21/SER-1) or an EPC URN (urn:epc:id:sgtin:...). Use this before putting any identifier into an EPCIS document. Never guess a check digit and never derive a new identifier by changing a digit of an existing one — ask this tool instead.

identifier.description: A GS1 Digital Link URI or EPC URN

name: validateIdentifier
title: Validate a GS1 identifier
